final: WITH player_totals AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) as total_diff FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country != '' AND a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(total_diff) as avg_diff FROM player_totals), above_avg AS (SELECT pt.total_diff, (pt.total_diff - (SELECT avg_diff FROM avg_calc)) as excess FROM player_totals pt WHERE pt.total_diff > (SELECT avg_diff FROM avg_calc)) SELECT SUM(total_diff) as sum_of_totals, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
